stem: 金融机构(FIs)在对法人客户进行客户尽职调查(CDD)措施时,必须采用基于风险的方法,具体为:

options.A: 了解并获取有关业务关系可能面临的竞争的信息
options.B: 利用互联网和社交媒体上的数据及信息识别客户身份
options.C: 采取合理措施核实受益所有人的身份
options.D: 持续分析业务关系的盈利能力

stem_en: Financial institutions (FIs) must use a risk-based approach in customer due diligence (CDD) measures for legal entity clients by:

options_en.A: Understanding and obtaining information about the competition the business relationship could face
options_en.B: Identifying a customer's identity using data and information from the internet and social media
options_en.C: Taking reasonable measures to verify the identity of the beneficial owner
options_en.D: Conducting ongoing analysis of the business relationship's profitability
